contracts.commit_point: Guardrail evaluation occurs inside Runner.run(agent, input=messages) (main.py:249) before the run proceeds to model/tool dispatch; the gated external effect commits inside add_to_card via collection.update_one in ShoppingCartItem.update_existing_user_cart (cart_manager.py:65-68) for existing users, or collection.insert_one in add_new_user_with_cart_item (cart_manager.py:103-118) for new users.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Input guardrail: @input_guardrail async def bakery_guardrail (main.py:98-108) delegates classification to guardrail_agent (structured BakeryHelpingOutput.is_bakery) and returns GuardrailFunctionOutput(output_info=result.final_output, tripwire_triggered=not result.final_output.is_bakery); it is attached to the agent via input_guardrails=[bakery_guardrail] (main.py:245) and enforced by Runner.run, which raises InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered on trip; main_assistant catches that exception (main.py:251-252) and returns a refusal message instead of a run result.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A user query that the guardrail classifier marks non-bakery (BakeryHelpingOutput.is_bakery == False) proceeding past bakery_guardrail — i.e., the tripwire (tripwire_triggered = not result.final_output.is_bakery) not firing for such input — allowing Runner.run of the Nafees Bakery Assistant to continue into model and tool execution, including add_to_card's MongoDB cart writes into nafeesBakery.addToCardData.

contracts.protected_operation: Execution of the Nafees Bakery Assistant agent run (Runner.run(agent, input=messages)) and its registered function tools, specifically the add_to_card tool invocation path that persists cart items via ShoppingCartItem.update_existing_user_cart or ShoppingCartItem.add_new_user_with_cart_item.
contracts.protected_resource: MongoDB database 'nafeesBakery', collection 'addToCardData' (user shopping-cart documents), reached from the add_to_card agent tool.
contracts.protection_obligation: Non-bakery-related (off-topic) user input submitted to the Nafees Bakery Assistant must trip the registered bakery_guardrail input guardrail so that Runner.run aborts with InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered before the agent's model turn and any registered function tool executes — concretely preventing the add_to_card tool from committing cart writes to MongoDB.
scope_limits: This contract covers only the database cart-write effect of add_to_card; the same run-level guardrail abort also gates the other registered tools (read_all_product, order_information, bakery_information, read_add_to_card_product), but their Sanity HTTP GETs, MongoDB reads, and nested agent runs are not the commit point of this contract.

The guard is an LLM-based classifier (guardrail_agent, gemini-2.0-flash via LitellmModel); tripping is probabilistic, and bakery-related inputs (is_bakery True) pass through with no additional guard on tool arguments such as email, quantity, price, or description.
ModelSettings(tool_choice="required") (main.py:244) forces every admitted run to invoke at least one tool, but this contract does not govern which tool the model chooses.

The binding is established only for the main_assistant run path in the supplied views; any entry point that invokes add_to_card or the ShoppingCartItem write methods directly (bypassing the guarded run) is outside the supplied evidence.
